title: Gold, silver prices rise on bargain buying, dip in crude oil rates - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
In global markets, spot gold gained $53.96, or 1.3%, to $4,348.10 per ounce, while silver rose 1.5% to $64.61 an ounce.

Gold prices snapped a three-session losing streak on Wednesday, rising ₹1,200 to ₹1.55 lakh per 10 grams in the national capital as bargain buying by traders and easing crude oil prices boosted sentiment towards bullion.

The yellow metal of 99.9 per cent purity appreciated by ₹1,200 to ₹1,55,600 per 10 grams (inclusive of all taxes) from Tuesday's closing level of ₹1,54,400 per 10 grams, according to local traders.

Capri Gold Loans rolls out ‘Vyapar Mahotsav’

Silver also bounced back after holding steady for two straight sessions, surging ₹7,400 to ₹2.42 lakh per kilogram (inclusive of all taxes) against the previous close of ₹2,34,600 per kg.

Gold prices edged higher on Wednesday as traders resorted to bargain buying after three consecutive sessions of losses, Saumil Gandhi, Senior Analyst - Commodities at HDFC Securities, said.

A pullback in crude oil prices improved sentiment towards bullion, while a softer tone in US Treasury yields ahead of the US Federal Reserve's policy decision provided additional support to precious metals, Gandhi added.

In global markets, spot gold gained $53.96, or 1.3 per cent, to $4,348.10 per ounce, while silver rose 1.5 per cent to $64.61 an ounce.

Gold mining stocks offer better returns than bullion: Rational Equity Asset Management

Spot gold rose over 1 per cent to trade around $4,350 per ounce during the session but remained largely confined to either side of the $4,300 mark as investors awaited the Federal Open Market Committee's monetary policy decision later in the day, Praveen Singh, Head of Commodities at Mirae Asset Sharekhan, said.

Gold's resilience despite a sharp rise in oil prices on Tuesday reflected uncertainty over the Fed's stance going forward, Singh said.

"Investors are interested in knowing whether this rate hike could be one-off hike or could become a series of hike," he added.

Markets are expecting a 25 basis points rate hike by the Federal Reserve in this meeting.
